records.why: DEFERRED, four-level rubric (journal item math_1_1-070, 'Use the KICD criteria and the levels prescribed'). KICD prescribes four levels (Exceeds, Meets, Approaches, Below Expectations) but the partner contract has only three level fields (excellent, proficient, developing), so Below Expectations cannot be stored or printed yet. The KICD Below Expectations wording is: indicator 1 'The learner correctly classifies whole numbers as odd, even, prime, or composite numbers'; indicator 2 'The learner partially determines the reciprocal of real numbers by division or tables or calculators'; indicator 3 'The leaner partially applies the reciprocal of real numbers in mathematical computations with prompts'. Not applied pending the partner's decision on a fourth field; teachers can add it by hand to the printed rubric.
records.resolved_note: Resolved 2026-11-10: the four-level rubric (Below Expectations) is now in this module's Final Explanation (contract revision R1 and the KICD rubric); the deferral no longer applies.
